build_bev_iou_cpu: build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on CPU
build_bev_iou_gpu: build a python module to compute bird's eye view IoU between two sets of 3D boxes on GPU
build_iou3d_gpu: build a python module to compute full 3D IoU between two sets of 3D oriented boxes on GPU
run_nms_gpu: run rotated 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU
run_nms_normal_gpu: run standard 3D NMS on a set of 3D boxes with scores and an IoU threshold on GPU
